tools.name: get_index_constituents
tools.description:
S&P 500 (or other index) constituents as understood on `as_of_date` (YYYY-MM-DD),
survivorship-free. Point-in-time, with lineage.

tools.name: get_fundamentals
tools.description:
Point-in-time fundamentals for `ticker` as known on `as_of_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
Returns each available metric's value for the fiscal period with source + knowledge time +
lineage under `metrics`. Any requested metric with no value appears under `unavailable` with

tools.name: get_filing_metadata
tools.description: SEC filings for `ticker` available on `as_of_date`, newest first, with amendment linkage.

tools.name: get_earnings_event
tools.description:
Earnings event: 8-K acceptance timestamp, as-reported figures, and the derived realized
price reaction. `fiscal_period` is FY or Q1..Q4.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_fundamentals" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
